description: Fetch a YouTube video's transcript via SerpAPI. `v` is the video id from a youtube_search result. Pick a track with language_code (default 'en' — use the video's own language), and optionally title and type ('asr' for auto-generated captions). When the requested track doesn't exist the tool falls back once to an available track (same language first, manual before auto-generated) and says so in `note`.

language_code.description: Transcript language code, e.g. 'en', 'pl'. Default 'en' — pass the video's own language. If that track doesn't exist, an available one is used instead and `note` says which.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh SerpAPI fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

title.description: Transcript track title to select when multiple tracks exist.

type.description: Transcript track type: 'asr' for auto-generated captions; omit for manual captions. If that track doesn't exist, an available one is used instead and `note` says which.

v.description: YouTube video id (required) — the id from a youtube_search result.

zero_trace.description: Enterprise-only ZeroTrace mode: don't store search params/metadata on SerpAPI. Default false.

name: youtube_transcript
title: Get YouTube Transcript (SerpAPI)
